These are the KICad files of a Nano version of the programer

@NelsonBittencourt note: 
There is an error in this PicArd Nano version. The Nano board 5V pin is an input pin, not an output. Thus, when using USB to power the board, the 5V pin will provide (5V-{diode voltage drop}). To correct this, connect the PicArd 5V pin directly to USB 5V rail.
